articles.title: Djokovic comes back as Sabalenka starts strongly in Beijing
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic recovered from losing the first set to win in Beijing. Aryna Sabalenka also won, hitting 11 aces and discussing her effort to be easier on herself.

articles.title: Alcaraz and Kartal win on their return to tour tennis
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz won a three-set match in Japan. Sonay Kartal won in Beijing on her return to the WTA Tour after almost six months out with a back injury.

articles.title: Pikachu plush returns from a real space trip
articles.summary: A Pikachu plush spent 67 days aboard the International Space Station. Its journey is part of a European Space Agency project linking Pokémon with space science.
